codes.title: 10th Anniversary – 500K Community Check-Ins
codes.description: To celebrate 10 years of Pokémon GO, Trainers can unlock a promo code for 10 Max Mushrooms if the community reaches 500,000 worldwide check-ins at community meetups by November 14, 2026. The code has not been announced yet. It is expected to expire after Pokémon GO Wild Area ends, but the expiration date has not been confirmed.

codes.title: LEGO × Pokémon GO Berries
codes.description: Promo code for free berries and Poké Balls tied to the Pokémon GO and LEGO Group partnership. Learn more here.

codes.title: adidas Shoes Avatar Item
codes.description: Complete your outfit with a pair of adidas shoes for your avatar! Redeem this promo code in the Pokémon GO Web Store by Friday, January 15, 2027.

codes.title: FENDI x FRGMT x POKÉMON Hoodie Avatar Item
codes.description: This code rewarded an exclusive FENDI x FRGMT x POKÉMON hoodie avatar item. It has expired; the exact expiration date is unknown.

rewards.name: FENDI x FRGMT x POKÉMON hoodie

codes.titleDe: FENDI x FRGMT x POKÉMON Hoodie Avatar-Artikel

codes.title: MLB-branded T-shirt Avatar Item
codes.description: To celebrate the Pokémon GO and Major League Baseball collaboration returning for the 2026 season, trainers can redeem this code to get an exclusive MLB-branded T-shirt avatar item. Offer code available for redemption until September 30, 2026. Learn more here.

codes.title: LEGO × Pokémon GO Cap Timed Research
codes.description: Redeem this promo code for Bonus Timed Research that awards berries, XP, Stardust, and the 2026 LEGO® Pokémon Cap. The Cap Timed Research is unavailable in Japan, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia, where LEGO® Pokémon™ products are not sold. Trainers in these regions can still redeem the code for alternate Timed Research with different rewards, including a Lucky Egg. Tasks must be completed and rewards claimed before Wednesday, September 30, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. local time. Research details here.
codes.titleDe: LEGO × Pokémon GO-Mütze – Zeitlich begrenzte Forschung

codes.title: Pokémon Horizons Bonus Timed Research
codes.description: Redeem the code shared during the Pokémon Horizons: The Series anime broadcast for Timed Research rewarding an encounter with Charmander wearing Friede’s goggles with a Special Background, 35 Poké Balls, 5 Razz Berries, 10,000 XP, and 5,000 Stardust. Redeem the code, complete the tasks, and claim rewards by Tuesday, September 22, 2026, at 8:00 p.m. local time. Research details here.
codes.titleDe: Zeitlich begrenzte Bonus-Forschung zu Pokémon Horizons

codes.title: 2026 Worlds Tee (Green) Avatar Item
codes.description: Redeem this promo code for the 2026 Worlds Tee (Green) avatar item from the 2026 Pokémon World Championships. Expires Friday, September 11, 2026, at 20:00 UTC. More details here.

codes.title: GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale – 1M Check-Ins
codes.description: Redeem this promo code for 1 Premium Battle Pass and 10 Ultra Balls to help prepare for Armored Mewtwo, celebrating 1 million community check-ins during Mega Ascension and Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Mega Finale.

codes.title: GO Fest 2026: Global – 750K Check-Ins
codes.description: To celebrate Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Global, this code unlocked after the community reached 750K check-ins at local meetups. Check-in window was July 11 at 6 a.m. to July 12 at 8 p.m. local time. Trainers at the maximum Link Charge capacity will need to free up space before redeeming this reward code.

codes.title: GO Fest 2026: Global – 750K RSVPs
codes.description: To celebrate Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Global, this code unlocked after the community reached 750K RSVPs to local meetups. RSVP window was July 7 at midnight to July 11 at 10 a.m. local time. Trainers at the maximum Link Charge capacity will need to free up space before redeeming this reward code.
